card.name: Word endings that close a medical phrase
card.fires_on: The last piece of a noun that ends a medical phrase, such as infection, psoriasis, dose, infants or dosage. It fires where a heading or clause is about to finish and a bracket, period or new section follows.

modes.label: Condition endings
modes.description: The noun naming a disease or condition ends a phrase, often infection or a split-up disease name.
modes.example: test patients for hepatitis B virus<< infection>> [see Warnings and Precautions

modes.label: Dose and population endings
modes.description: The final piece of a dosing or patient-group word in a heading or table.
modes.example: Treatment duration is provided in Recommended Dos<<age>> (Table 1).

card.writes: The promoted tokens are word-ending pieces like 'agers', 'ants' and 'ties', so it may push the model toward finishing a word and phrase.
card.plain: It marks the last word of a medical phrase, like infection or dose, just before the phrase ends.
